summary: Tested Job Income 3-step wizard implementation. All features working correctly: Step 1 (Who pays you?) with Company Name and Income Type toggle, Step 2 (How much & how often?) with Amount and Payment Frequency grid, Step 3 (When to expect?) with conditional schedule fields. Text inputs retain values without page refresh. Complete save flow works. Edit mode shows all fields at once with numbered section headers. Add Income type picker page unchanged.
critical_code_review_comments: JobIncome.js: Step components implemented as plain JSX variables (step1Content, step2Content, step3Content) instead of arrow functions - correctly prevents React remounting on re-render which was causing keystroke refresh issue
StepIndicator component shows checkmarks for completed steps and active ring for current step
Edit mode (when id param present) renders all 3 sections at once with numbered headers (1 Source, 2 Amount, 3 Schedule)
Validation per step: Step 1 validates company name, Step 2 validates amount and frequency, Step 3 validates conditional schedule fields based on frequency
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted test job 'Weekly Pay Corp' during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Job Income wizard fully tested. 3-step wizard works correctly with step indicator, validation, and conditional fields. Edit mode shows all fields at once. Add Income type picker page at /add-income unchanged with all 8 income types visible.

add_income_page_unchanged.details: Add Income page at /add-income shows all 8 income type options: Job, Business, Self-Employed, Rental, Commission, Interest, Dividend, Other

wizard_step1_who_pays_you.details: Step 1 shows 'Who pays you?' with Company Name input and Income Type toggle (Fixed/Variable). Next button validates company name is filled.

wizard_step2_how_much_how_often.details: Step 2 shows 'How much & how often?' with Amount input and Payment Frequency grid (Daily, Weekly, Monthly, Quarterly, Half-Yearly, Yearly, Others). Back + Next buttons present.

wizard_step3_when_to_expect.details: Step 3 shows 'When to expect?' with conditional schedule fields. For Monthly: date picker. For Weekly: day selector (Monday-Sunday). Save Job Income button at bottom.

text_input_no_refresh.details: Typing in Company Name and Amount inputs does NOT cause page refresh - text retained correctly. Verified 'Test Company XYZ' and '75000' values retained.

complete_save_flow.details: Complete flow from Step 1 to Save works - saves income to backend API and redirects to /my-job page showing new entry.

step_indicator.details: Step indicator shows checkmarks for completed steps (green circles with check icons) and active state (ring highlight) for current step.

edit_mode_all_fields.details: Edit mode shows all 3 sections at once with numbered headers (1 Source, 2 Amount, 3 Schedule). Update and Delete buttons visible. Pre-filled values displayed correctly.

weekly_frequency_day_selector.details: When Weekly frequency selected, Step 3 shows day selector with all 7 days (Monday-Sunday) as buttons.
